bio: Colourful drapes make for a cheerful aesthetic, and Indian music create a vibrant ambiance. This restaurant in Little India serves authentic Northern Indian dishes, such as fish amritsari – this red snapper in a thick, spicy curry with balanced flavours is a must! The palak paneer seduces with creamy spinach with a hint of cumin that complements the milky cheese. Round off your meal with the popular sweet gulab jamun....
